name: agentic-ai-software-company-starter
mixed_team_rule: operational agent/hybrid roles >= 12 - number_of_human_team_members by end of Session 2

role_model.session_1: current_actor_type and target_actor_type are separate; one own operational LangGraph agent required

assessment_note: Session 1 evaluates team delta: company setup, platform use, first own agent, tests/evidence, cost measurement, engineering process.

session_2_infrastructure_update.note: Supplied infrastructure and documentation update; not student achievement. Existing teams retain their original baseline and record this update separately.

session_3_infrastructure_update.note: Course-supplied Session 3 materials, evidence templates, CI artifacts, generic DB health errors and optional Ollama controls. Not student achievement. No customer implementation or own customer tests supplied.
